'''Bowman Gavin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], he flew a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|battle]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The battle was a success when the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] was destroyed, which included the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. In later years, although he had earned an impressive number of Alliance and New Republic combat decorations, the Endor campaign bar was the only which he regularly chose to wear on his uniform.

A dozen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after Endor, Gavin served as the director of flight personnel or "flight boss" for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Fleet]] during the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. In this role, he was responsible for assigning [[Plat Mallar]] as a shuttle pilot.
